entries.en: Added `claude ultrareview [target]` subcommand to run `/ultrareview` non-interactively from CI or scripts — prints findings to stdout (`--json` for raw output) and exits 0 on completion or 1 on failure
entries.zh: 添加了`claude ultrareview [target]`子命令，以便从 CI 或脚本以非交互方式运行`/ultrareview`——将结果打印到 stdout（原始输出为`--json`）并在完成时退出 0 或在失败时退出 1

entries.en: Skills can now reference the current effort level with `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` in their content
entries.zh: 技能内容现在可以使用 `${CLAUDE_EFFORT}` 引用当前的强度级别

entries.en: Set `AI_AGENT` environment variable for subprocesses so `gh` can attribute traffic to Claude Code
entries.zh: 为子进程设置 `AI_AGENT` 环境变量，使 `gh` 能把流量归因于 Claude Code

entries.en: Show a "use PgUp/PgDn to scroll" hint when the terminal sends arrow keys instead of scroll events
entries.zh: 当终端发送方向键而不是滚动事件时，显示 "use PgUp/PgDn to scroll" 提示

entries.en: Windows: Git for Windows (Git Bash) is no longer required — when absent, Claude Code uses PowerShell as the shell tool
entries.zh: Windows：不再必须安装 Git for Windows（Git Bash）；未安装时，Claude Code 会使用 PowerShell 作为 shell 工具

entries.en: Spinner tips that recommend installing the desktop app or creating skills/agents are now hidden when you already have them
entries.zh: 如果你已安装桌面应用或已创建技能/代理，相关的推荐提示现在会隐藏

entries.en: Faster session start when you have many claude.ai connectors configured but not authorized
entries.zh: 当您配置了许多 claude.ai 连接器但未授权时，会话启动速度更快

entries.en: The auto mode denial message now links to the configuration docs
entries.zh: 自动模式的拒绝消息现在会链接到配置文档

entries.en: `claude plugin validate` now accepts `$schema`, `version`, and `description` at the top level of `marketplace.json` and `$schema` in `plugin.json`
entries.zh: `claude plugin validate` 现在在 `marketplace.json` 顶层接受 `$schema`、`version` 和 `description`，并在 `plugin.json` 中接受 `$schema`

entries.en: [VSCode] `/usage` now opens the native Account & Usage dialog instead of returning plain-text session cost
entries.zh: [VSCode] `/usage` 现在会打开原生的 Account & Usage 对话框，而不再返回纯文本的会话费用

entries.en: [VSCode] Voice dictation now respects the `language` setting in `~/.claude/settings.json`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写现在会遵循 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中的 `language` 设置

entries.en: Auto-compact in auto mode now displays `auto` (lowercase, no token count) instead of a misleading token value
entries.zh: 自动模式下的自动压缩现在显示`auto`（小写，无令牌计数）而不是误导性的令牌值

entries.en: Fixed pressing Esc during a stdio MCP tool call closing the entire server connection (regression in 2.1.105)
entries.zh: 修复了在 stdio MCP 工具调用期间按 Esc 关闭整个服务器连接的问题（2.1.105 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed `/rewind` and other interactive overlays not responding to keyboard input after launching with `claude --resume`
entries.zh: 修复了使用`claude --resume`启动后`/rewind`和其他交互式叠加层不响应键盘输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminal scrollback duplication in non-fullscreen mode (resize, dialog dismiss, long sessions)
entries.zh: 修复非全屏模式下终端滚动缓冲区内容重复的问题（调整大小、关闭对话框、长会话时）

entries.en: Fixed `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` not suppressing usage metrics telemetry for API and enterprise users
entries.zh: 修复了`DISABLE_TELEMETRY`/`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`不抑制 API 和企业用户的使用指标遥测的问题

entries.en: Fixed false-positive "Dangerous rm operation" permission prompts in auto mode for multi-line bash commands containing both a pipe and a redirect
entries.zh: 修复了自动模式下包含管道和重定向的多行 bash 命令的误报“危险 rm 操作”权限提示

entries.en: Fixed long selection menus clipping below the terminal in fullscreen mode — the focused option now stays on screen as you scroll
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下长选择菜单在终端下方剪辑的问题 - 当您滚动时，焦点选项现在保留在屏幕上

entries.en: Fixed Write tool output collapsing instead of expanding when clicking "+N lines" in fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏中单击“+N 行”时写入工具输出折叠而不是展开的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command picker jumping while typing, and improved highlight to only match contiguous substrings in blue
entries.zh: 修复了打字时斜杠命令选择器跳跃的问题，并改进了突出显示以仅匹配蓝色的连续子字符串

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` marketplace failing to load when one entry uses an unrecognized source format — that entry is shown but installing it prompts you to update
entries.zh: 修复了当一个条目使用无法识别的源格式时`/plugin`市场无法加载的问题 - 该条目已显示，但安装它会提示您更新

entries.en: Fixed `find` in the Bash tool exhausting open file descriptors on large directory trees, causing host-wide crashes (macOS/Linux native builds)
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具中的`find`耗尽大型目录树上打开的文件描述符，导致主机范围崩溃（macOS/Linux 本机构建）
